auth.description: The auth string to create the REST instance for the source control gadget.

url.description: The API url for the source control host. Example: 'https://api.github.com'.

commitSha.description: The commit SHA on which code analysis is being performed.

prUrl.description: The PR url associated with the commit SHA on which code analysis is being performed, if any.

packagesPath.description: The path in source control which leads to the packages which should be processed by this build.

branch.description: The branch of which the Jarvis build was triggered.

repositoryName.description: The name of the repository for which the Jarvis build was triggered.

organizationName.description: The name of the organization to which #repositoryName belongs.

sourceControlHost.description: The source control host. This field is inferred from the #restApi type.

backupSourceControlTokens.description:
A list of backup source control tokens to use if the primary source control token hits
secondary rate limits.
